name: Validating Japanese Addresses
description: validateAddress on Japanese addresses: a postal code that delivers to another prefecture, a municipality in another prefecture, one not in the table, and one two prefectures share. A null code means no Japan-specific finding is expected.

findings.name: warn when the postal code delivers to another prefecture
findings.input: 〒530-0001 東京都千代田区丸の内1-2-3

expected.message: Postal code 530-0001 belongs to 大阪府, not 東京都

findings.name: make the postal mismatch an error with strict postal validation
findings.input: 〒530-0001 東京都千代田区丸の内1-2-3

expected.message: Postal code 530-0001 belongs to 大阪府, not 東京都

findings.name: warn when the municipality is in another prefecture
findings.input: 東京都大阪市北区梅田1-1

expected.message: 大阪市北区 is in 大阪府, not 東京都

findings.name: warn when the municipality is not in the table

expected.message: 架空市 is not a municipality in the table

findings.name: warn when the municipality's name is shared and nothing chooses

expected.message: 府中市 could be in 東京都 or 広島県; add the prefecture or postal code

findings.name: warn when no postal code begins with the first three digits
findings.input: 〒000-0000 東京都千代田区丸の内1-2-3

expected.message: No Japanese postal code begins with 000

findings.name: accept a correct address with no region finding
findings.input: 〒100-0005 東京都千代田区丸の内1丁目2番3号 丸ビル5階

findings.name: accept a correct romaji address with no region finding
accept a postal code on the far side of a border prefix
findings.input: 〒311-4411 栃木県芳賀郡茂木町桧山123
